title: UX Task Flow Compiler
description: Validates task flow specs: step ordering, actor assignments, completion criteria, failure paths, retry caps, and abandonment recovery. Produces task-flow-artifact.json consumed by state-matrix and execution compilers.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract task-flow-spec.json from feature brief and task definitions

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec fields and step ordering

pipeline.title: Coverage
pipeline.description: Validate completion criteria, failure paths, and step actors

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate retry cap and abandonment recovery policies

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: task-flow-spec.json exists with task_id, steps array, and completion_criteria array

gates.title: Step Order
gates.description: Steps have unique sequential order integers (0,1,2... or 1,2,3...) with no gaps

gates.title: Completion Criteria
gates.description: completion_criteria is non-empty and each criterion has a description string

gates.title: Failure Paths
gates.description: At least one failure or cancellation path exists in the task flow

gates.title: Step Actors
gates.description: Every step has actor=user|system|both; parallel steps have parallelGroup id

gates.title: Retry Cap
gates.description: All retryable steps have maxRetries <= 5; retryable:true without maxRetries is forbidden

gates.title: Abandoned Recovery
gates.description: When spec.abandonable=true, resumeFrom or recovery_entry must be declared

gates.title: Task Flow Contract
gates.description: Version declared, unique step ids, at least one step with actor=user

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled task flow specs

error_codes.UTK001: task-flow-spec.json missing or invalid — task_id, steps, completion_criteria required
error_codes.UTK002: Step order invalid — order values must be unique sequential integers with no gaps
error_codes.UTK003: completion_criteria empty or criterion missing description
error_codes.UTK004: No failure or cancellation path declared in task flow
error_codes.UTK005: Retry violation — retryable step missing maxRetries or maxRetries > 5
error_codes.UTK007: Step missing actor field or parallel step missing parallelGroup
error_codes.UTK008: Task flow contract violation — version, unique step ids, or user actor missing
